EN: Running after the Brahmin to help out the Merchant. That thing is fast!
ZH: 帮助商人追逐双头牛。那东西很快！

EN: Staying low to the ground as I cross the Field as quickly as possible.
ZH: 匍匐在地上，尽可能快地穿过田野。

EN: Guess I'll go this way.
ZH: 我想我会走这条路。

EN: I really should be drawing a map.
ZH: 我真的应该画一幅地图。

EN: Ow. Rock in my shoe.
ZH: 嗷。我的鞋里进了石头。

EN: Legs are cramping. But I must go on.
ZH: 腿抽筋了。但是还得继续。

EN: Hmm. Something over there?
ZH: 嗯，那边有东西？

EN: Could be something over there.
ZH: 那里可能有东西。

EN: This way looks as good as any other.
ZH: 这条路看起来跟别的路也差不多。

EN: Sure wish I had a traveling buddy.
ZH: 真希望我有个旅伴。

EN: Have I started talking to myself? I can't tell.
ZH: 我是不是开始自言自语了？我自己也说不准。

EN: I'm going to need such a bath when I get home.
ZH: 回家以后真得好好洗个澡。

EN: Is someone following me?
ZH: 有人跟踪我吗？

EN: These tracks - human, or something else?
ZH: 这些痕迹——是人类吗？还是其他的？

EN: Hello? Anybody out here?
ZH: 喂？外面有人吗？

EN: What was that?
ZH: 那是什么？

EN: The Vault is counting on me. I won't let them down.
ZH: 避难所的人们正指望着我。我不会让他们失望的。

EN: Clouds on the horizon. Hope it doesn't rain.
ZH: 天边有乌云。希望不会下雨。

EN: I'll follow this road, see where it goes.
ZH: 我选这条路，看它会带我去何方。

EN: A crossroads. Left or right? Let's try left.
ZH: 十字路口。向左还是向右？试试左边吧。

EN: A crossroads. Left or right? I guess I'll go right.
ZH: 十字路口。向左还是向右？还是往右边吧。

EN: It sure gets lonely out here.
ZH: 在外面待久了，还真是孤单啊。

EN: Should I head back to the Vault? Maybe in a bit.
ZH: 我应该回避难所吗？也许再过一会儿吧。

EN: It's quiet. Too quiet.
ZH: 好安静。太安静了。

EN: Wonder what's over there.
ZH: 不知道那里有什么。

EN: I'll climb that ridge and get the lay of the land.
ZH: 我要爬上那道山脊，看看周围的地形。

EN: I sense danger everywhere...
ZH: 我感觉危险无处不在……

EN: Just got to keep moving forward.
ZH: 只需要继续前进。

EN: I'd be totally lost without my Pip-Boy.
ZH: 要不是有哔哔小子，我肯定迷路了。

EN: Broken branches. Something passed through here.
ZH: 断枝。一定有东西经过这里。

EN: Nowhere to go but straight ahead.
ZH: 除了硬着头皮往前走，已经无处可去了。

EN: Fresh tracks. Can't tell what made them.
ZH: 新鲜的痕迹。看不出是什么留下的。

EN: I bet this neighborhood was nice once.
ZH: 我敢打赌这片社区曾经一定很棒。

EN: Hard to imagine people actually living out here.
ZH: 很难想象人们真的住在这种地方。

EN: The more supplies I bring back to the Vault, the better.
ZH: 我能带回避难所的物资越多越好。

EN: I'm going to have such blisters tomorrow...
ZH: 我明天会起水泡……

EN: I'll head that way. Might be something interesting.
ZH: 我要走那条路。说不定会发生什么有趣的事情。

EN: Hmm? Something over there?
ZH: 嗯？那边有东西？

EN: Fresh tracks. Animal, or... worse?
ZH: 新鲜的痕迹。动物的？或者……更可怕的？

EN: Should I go that way? Hmmm. No, I'll go this way.
ZH: 我应该走那条路吗？嗯……算了，我还是走这条吧。

EN: Wonder if someone will give me a massage when I get back.
ZH: 不知道回去会不会有人给我做按摩。

EN: Ow, my aching feet...
ZH: 嗷，我的脚好痛……

EN: If the others could only see how bad it is for themselves...
ZH: 真想让其他人也亲眼看看这外面有多糟……

EN: Sky looks funny over there. Storm might be coming.
ZH: 那边的天空看起来有点不对劲。暴风雨可能要来了。

EN: A fork in the road. Guess I'll go left.
ZH: 一个岔路口。我选左边。

EN: A fork in the road. Guess I'll go right.
ZH: 一个岔路口。我选右边。

EN: Think I'll go down this path.
ZH: 我想我会走这条小路。

EN: This path looks good.
ZH: 这条小路看起来不错。

EN: Hmm... Broken plants. Someone pass by here?
ZH: 嗯……植物被踩折了。有人从这儿经过？

EN: Never knew I could sweat so much!
ZH: 从来不知道我能流这么多汗！

EN: This sure is good exercise, if nothing else.
ZH: 别的先不说，这好歹算是不错的锻炼。

EN: Thought I saw something...
ZH: 还以为看见什么了……

EN: What was that sound?
ZH: 那是什么声音？

EN: Traveling alone sure is, well... lonely.
ZH: 独自旅行嘛，呃……还真是孤独。

EN: Need to bring supplies back to the Vault. Focus on that...
ZH: 得把物资带回避难所。专心想这个……

EN: All this walking is murder on my feet.
ZH: 这一路走下来，我这双脚可遭了大罪。

EN: Good thing I'm wearing sensible footwear!
ZH: 还好我穿着合脚的鞋子。

EN: Calves, thighs, knees - they're all hurting.
ZH: 小腿，大腿，膝盖——都好痛。

EN: Sweat in my eyes. Ouch.
ZH: 汗水流进了眼睛。嗷。

EN: I'll head back to the Vault. But not yet. Not yet...
ZH: 我会回到避难所的。但现在还不是时候……不是时候……

EN: When I get back to the Vault, they'll hail me as a hero!
ZH: 当我回到避难所的时候，他们会把我当作英雄！

EN: Looks like a lake. Definitely don't want to go swimming in THAT.
ZH: 看起来像个湖。可绝对别想让我下去游泳。

EN: On the ground. Is that dried... blood?
ZH: 地上那干的东西……是血？

EN: Looks like a trail of paint. Oh, wait. Nope. That's blood.
ZH: 看起来像油漆。哦，等等。不。那是血。

EN: I'm a bundle of nerves...
ZH: 我现在可是紧张得不行……

EN: Okay, I'll admit it. I'm terrified.
ZH: 好吧，我承认。我吓坏了。

EN: I won't give in to my fear. I won't give in to my fear.
ZH: 我不会向恐惧屈服。我不会向恐惧屈服。

EN: I'd whistle a tune, but my mouth is too dry.
ZH: 我想吹口哨，但我的嘴巴太干了。

EN: If I get lost out here, I'm in serious trouble.
ZH: 如果我在这里迷路可就出大事了。

EN: People actually live out here? Ugh.
ZH: 真的有人住在这种地方吗？呃。

EN: Oh, that's a nice little house. Or at least it was.
ZH: 哦，那是一个很好的小房子。至少曾经是。

EN: Looks like an old store. Wonder what they sold?
ZH: 看起来像一个旧商店。不知道他们卖什么？

EN: Oh look, an old bus stop. Sure wish I could catch a ride.
ZH: 哦，看，一个旧的公共汽车站。真希望我能搭一趟车。

EN: Am I talking to myself? I think I am. Uh oh.
ZH: 我是在跟自己说话吗？我想我是。糟了。

EN: An old elementary school. Wow, that's not depressing at all...
ZH: 一所破旧的小学。哇，真是半点都不让人沮丧……

EN: I'll keep going this way.
ZH: 我会继续走这条路。

EN: Think I'll head that way for awhile.
ZH: 我打算往那边走上一阵子。

EN: Time to turn back? Nah.
ZH: 是时候回去了？算了。

EN: An old coffee shop. Sure could go for a cup of joe right about now.
ZH: 一个旧咖啡馆？现在要能喝上一杯咖啡就太棒了。

EN: Is that...an old Nuka-Cola factory? Too bad it's destroyed.
ZH: 那是……一个旧核子可乐工厂吗？被摧毁了，真是糟糕。

EN: I hear chanting. Probably some crazy cult. Better keep my distance.
ZH: 我听到有人在诵经。可能是哪个疯狂的邪教吧。我最好保持距离。

EN: An old hospital. Looks like it's been picked clean.
ZH: 一家旧医院。看上去被洗劫一空。

EN: Some old department store. No clothes left.
ZH: 一家旧百货商场。一件衣服都没剩。

EN: Oh look, an old baseball diamond. Nobody's run those bases in a long time.
ZH: 哦，一个旧棒球场。很久没人在这儿跑垒了。

EN: Hasn't been a touchdown in that old football field in two hundred years.
ZH: 已经两百年没有人在那个旧橄榄球场触地得分了。

EN: Looks like debris from an old plane crash.
ZH: 看起来像是曾经飞机失事时留下的残骸。

EN: An old, crashed vertibird. From the Army, before the war.
ZH: 一架坠毁的老式垂直起降机。战前军队的装备。

EN: Now that is one big house. Still couldn't stop an atomic bomb.
ZH: 嚯，那栋房子可真够大。可再大也挡不住原子弹。

EN: A drained swimming pool filled with skeletons. Lovely.
ZH: 一个干涸的游泳池，里面全是骷髅。真是妙极了。

EN: I think that building was... a hotel? An apartment complex?
ZH: 我看那栋楼以前是……酒店？还是公寓楼？

EN: A rusty old playground. So sad.
ZH: 一个锈迹斑斑的老游乐场。真让人难过。

EN: Wind's picking up...
ZH: 起风了……

EN: Need to control my breathing. Stay calm.
ZH: 需要控制我的呼吸。保持冷静。

EN: Another rusty old car.
ZH: 又一辆生锈的旧汽车。

EN: Ouch! Leg cramp!
ZH: 嗷！腿抽筋！

EN: Time for a break? Maybe later.
ZH: 该休息了吗？还是等会吧。

EN: I've got to keep moving.
ZH: 我必须走了。

EN: The Overseer made the right choice, choosing me for this.
ZH: 监督者选我来干这趟差事，真是选对人了。

EN: The longer I'm out here, the more danger I'm in.
ZH: 我在这里的时间越长，就越是危险。

EN: I can feel my heart racing.
ZH: 我能感觉到我的心跳加速。

EN: Just being out here gives me an adrenaline rush!
ZH: 光是待在这外面就够我肾上腺素飙升了！

EN: The wind is whistling. Sounds like voices.
ZH: 风声呜咽，听着倒像人说话。

EN: Hello? Can anybody hear me?
ZH: 喂？有人能听见我说话吗？

EN: Your eyes start to play tricks on you out here.
ZH: 在这外面待久了，眼睛都会开始骗你。

EN: That hill looks like a good vantage point.
ZH: 那座山头看起来是个不错的瞭望点。

EN: Whoa! I tripped over some rubble.
ZH: 嗷！被碎石绊了一下。

EN: My Pip-Boy sure is coming in handy out here.
ZH: 我的哔哔小子在这外面可真是帮了大忙。

EN: Pew! I stink.
ZH: 呸！我身上好臭。

EN: My soles are wearing out.
ZH: 我的鞋底快磨破了。

EN: So much dust and grime everywhere.
ZH: 到处都是灰尘和污垢。

EN: Oh good, this road slopes downwards. Easier on the legs.
ZH: 太好了，这段是下坡，省腿力。

EN: Let me just climb over this rubble...
ZH: 我来翻过这堆碎石……

EN: I'll cut through this destroyed building.
ZH: 我要从这栋被毁的建筑里穿过去。

EN: Those buildings have completely fallen into the street.
ZH: 那几栋楼整个塌进了街道。

EN: Now I know how Hansel and Gretel felt.
ZH: 总算体会到汉赛尔与格蕾特的心情了。

EN: A shower is going to feel so great when I get home.
ZH: 回家后冲个澡一定爽翻了。

EN: Is that... music? A radio somewhere, maybe?
ZH: 那是……音乐？附近哪里可能有台收音机？

EN: Smoke on the horizon. Could be a campfire. Or something else...
ZH: 远处有烟，可能是篝火，也可能是别的东西……

EN: An old fire station. Even they couldn't stop the world from burning.
ZH: 一座旧消防站。可就连他们也没能拦住世界燃烧。

EN: Maybe I'll head this way for awhile.
ZH: 也许我该朝这条路走一会儿。

EN: Should I go east?
ZH: 我应该往东吗？

EN: Should I go north?
ZH: 我应该往北吗？

EN: Should I go west?
ZH: 我应该往西吗？

EN: Should I go south?
ZH: 我应该往南吗？

EN: Guess I'll head east for a bit.
ZH: 我想我会往东走一会儿。

EN: Guess I'll head north for a bit.
ZH: 我想我会往北走一会儿。

EN: Guess I'll head west for a bit.
ZH: 我想我会往西走一会儿。

EN: Guess I'll head south for a bit.
ZH: 我想我会往南走一会儿。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. The Wasteland is a cruel, inhospitable place.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：废土是个残酷而不宜生存的地方。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Getting hungry. Craving Salisbury Steak.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：肚子饿了。馋索尔兹伯里牛排了。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Always thirsty. Need to stay hydrated.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：总是口渴。得随时补水。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. It's gone. It's all gone.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：不见了。一切都不见了。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Cars litter the roads. None drivable.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：路上到处都是废弃的车。没一辆还能开。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. So many skeletons. The world is a grave.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：这么多骷髅。这个世界就是一座坟墓。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Some pre-war food is still edible. Preservatives.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：有些战前食物还能吃。全靠防腐剂。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Law and order are things of the past.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：法律和秩序是过去的事情了。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. The world is still largely irradiated.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：世界大部分地区仍有辐射。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. The flora and fauna all seem pretty... weird.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：这里的动植物看起来都挺……怪的。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Life thrives where it can out here.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：在这外面，生命总能在夹缝里繁衍。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Many buildings remain. Damage extensive.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：许多建筑物仍然存在。但损坏严重。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Most water undrinkable. Too much radiation.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：大部分水都没法喝。辐射太重。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Bottle Caps accepted as currency everywhere.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：瓶盖成了通用的货币。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Slavers prey on the weak. My heart breaks.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：奴隶贩子专挑弱者下手。真让人心碎。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Food is scarce. Some resort to cannibalism.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：食物匮乏。有些人被迫吃人。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. A Yao Guai is a fierce, mutated bear.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：妖怪熊是一种凶猛的变异熊。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. A Ghoul is an irradiated human. Disfigured.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：尸鬼是被辐射改变的人类。面目全非。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Raiders are everywhere. Stealing. Murdering.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：掠夺者无处不在。偷窃。谋杀。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Feral Ghouls are basically zombies. Must avoid.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：狂尸鬼跟僵尸差不多。千万要躲开。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Mole rats are NOT cute...
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：鼹鼠一点都不可爱……

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Super Mutants hate humans. They'll kill on sight.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：超级变种人憎恨人类，见人就杀。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Giant ants are, indeed, giant ants.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：巨型蚂蚁——没错，就是巨大的蚂蚁。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Radroaches. They really can survive anything.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：辐射蟑螂。它们能在任何环境里存活。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. The military is gone. Replaced by mercenaries.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：军队已经不存在了。被雇佣兵所取代。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Most dogs no longer man's best friend.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：大多数狗不再是人类最好的朋友。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Squirrel tastes much better than you'd think.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：松鼠尝起来比想象的好得多。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Thought I saw a UFO, but that would be impossible...
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：还以为自己看见了 UFO，不过那不可能是真的……

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Sea creatures now extremely dangerous. Still delicious.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：海洋生物如今危险至极。但依然很好吃。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Sunsets, once romantic, are now terrifying. Fear the night.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：日落曾经浪漫，如今却很可怕。当心黑夜。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. So very hungry. Wondering if human tastes like chicken.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：饿坏了。真想知道人肉吃起来是不是像鸡肉。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Super Mutants are big. Behemoths, more so.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：超级变种人块头很大。巨兽型就更大了。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Money replaced by soda bottle Caps. Hands always sticky.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：汽水瓶盖代替了钱。双手总是黏糊糊的。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. The comics were wrong. Radiation does not grant super powers.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：漫画都是骗人的。辐射才不会给你超能力。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Love does not conquer all. Nukes come close.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：爱不能战胜一切。核武器几乎可以。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Bigger not always better. Case in point – roaches and scorpions.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：块头大不一定就好。瞧瞧蟑螂和蝎子。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Super Mutants are asexual. Before transformation, some were women.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：超级变种人没有性别。变异之前，有些原本是女性。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Junk is everywhere, but has multiple uses.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：杂物无处不在，但有多种用途。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Power Armor still exists, but is rare. Affords maximum protection.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：动力装甲依然存在，但很少见。防护性能拉满。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Found a fat man willing to share food. May live another day.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：找到了一个愿意分享食物的胖子。又可以多活一天。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Many Mister Handy robots remain. Use expressions like, “bloody barmy.”
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：许多巧手先生还在。它们会冒出诸如“疯得没边儿”这样的口头禅。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Fruits and vegetables still grow, but are mutated, like so much else.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：水果和蔬菜还在生长，但和其他很多东西一样，都变异了。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Homemade weapons abound. Humans still excel at killing each other.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：自制武器比比皆是。人类仍旧擅长杀死同类。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Radio still widely used, remains an effective means of communication.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：收音机仍被广泛使用，依旧是一种有效的通讯手段。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. We were wrong – cats not, in fact, extinct. But still lazy.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：我们错了——猫其实还没灭绝。但还是那么懒。

EN: Is that... a human head on a post? Okay, time to turn around...
ZH: 那是……插在杆子上的人头？好了，该掉头了……

EN: I may be scared senseless, but at least I'm getting some cardio.
ZH: 我也许是吓得魂飞魄散，但好歹算锻炼了心肺。

EN: Getting peckish. Snack time?
ZH: 越来越饿。该吃点心了吧？

EN: Huh. What's that flashing thing? How is OH MY GOD I'M IN A MINEFIELD. Sloowwwlly now...
ZH: 嗯？什么东西在闪？怎么会——哦我的天，我进雷区了！慢……慢……慢点挪……

EN: Oh look, a destroyed pizzeria. Maybe we can have a Vault pizza night when I get back...
ZH: 快看，一家被毁的披萨店。等我回去，咱们避难所也办个“披萨之夜”吧……

EN: There's ancient money everywhere. Guess you really can't take it with you.
ZH: 到处都是旧时代的钞票。看来钱真是生不带来、死不带去。

EN: An old Army transport. Looks like the soldiers tried to keep order. For a little while.
ZH: 一辆旧军用运输车。看来士兵们曾想维持秩序——也就撑了一小会儿。
